Title: GA: Vertical Pod Autoscaling add-on for AKS

Body.Content:
The Vertical Pod Autoscaling (VPA) add-on for AKS is now generally available. Vertical Pod Autoscaling is a Kubernetes open-source project which aims to help right size your workloads by setting up to date resource requests and limits for the containers in your pods based on past usage, ensuring stability, cost-efficiency, and improved cluster utilization for your workloads.

Learn more.
